speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth; have you experienced any pain specifically in your lower abdomen or pelvis?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Pelvic Thrombophlebitis.

The combination of prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, decreased bowel sounds, and fever suggests a pelvic thrombosis rather than endometritis or urinary tract infection. I will request a Lower Extremity Doppler Ultrasound and a D-Dimer test to confirm the diagnosis.
